description: This file defines the SettingsViewModel class for end-to-end testing of the Notesnook web application, including methods for interacting with settings such as logout, backup, restore, app lock, and editor preferences.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.description: A class providing methods to automate and test user interactions with the settings page of the Notesnook web app.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the settings view by focusing the search input and pressing Escape.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by navigating to Profile and confirming logout dialog.

methods.name: getRecoveryKey
methods.description: Retrieves the recovery key after navigating to Profile and confirming password.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently logged in by verifying visibility of the logged-in indicator.

methods.name: isBackupEncryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if backup encryption is enabled based on the checkbox state.

methods.name: toggleBackupEncryption
methods.description: Toggles backup encryption setting, optionally providing a password.

methods.name: createBackup
methods.description: Creates a backup and reads the backup file content.

methods.name: restoreData
methods.description: Restores data from a specified backup file, optionally with a password.

methods.name: selectImageCompression
methods.description: Selects an image compression option from a dropdown.

methods.name: enableAppLock
methods.description: Enables app lock with user and app lock passwords.

methods.name: disableAppLock
methods.description: Disables app lock using the app lock password.

methods.name: setTitleFormat
methods.description: Sets the default title format in the editor settings.
